description: Source code for a Drupal migration plugin class 'TextField' that handles migration of Drupal 6 text fields, including mapping widget types, format processing, and field type determination.

classes.name: TextField
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for migrating Drupal 6 text fields, defining widget and formatter mappings, processing pipelines, and field type logic.

methods.name: getFieldWidgetMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of widget types to their identifiers.

methods.name: getFieldFormatterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of formatter types to their identifiers.

methods.name: defineValueProcessPipeline
methods.description: Defines the processing pipeline for migrating field values based on widget type and format.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Determines the field type based on source row properties such as widget type and settings.
